title: A steady agreement allowing different efforts

captions.physics: Coordinating different needs through practical methods
captions.energy: Requiring equality of every domestic expenditure
captions.emotions: Feeling reliability through clear domestic boundaries

meaning: Your domestic support keeps its steadiness when coordination defines duties through actual conditions instead of reducing different needs to compulsory sameness of effort.
text: You can coordinate different domestic needs and choose manageable participation. Temperance in the physical position of Muladhara describes these actions. Justice in energy complicates them through literal mutual accounting. The Emperor in emotions wants steadiness and clear boundaries. An agreement can become excessively detailed. Both want understandable order, but every difference requires compensation. Instead of reliable conditions, more rules attempt to equalise actions differing in content, timing and each person’s current capacity within shared domestic life.

For example, one wants to cook less often while the other wants no late washing up. A suitable division is found, but argument again demands equal minutes and operations. **Clear responsibility need not take an identical form for every effort.** Task content can be named and manageability checked. Coordination supports both instead of steadiness depending on endless detail intended to exclude difference but actually making an ordinary domestic evening less simple and clear.

The difficulty is considering roughly proportionate participation already unreliable. Accounting increases while peaceful action diminishes. An examinable agreement offers more dependable support: specific duties and an available way to correct genuine imbalance. Arrangements let both know responsibility without proving identical expenditure each time or turning shared home into a system continually requiring fresh evidence of fair participation. Clear limits can include actual differences rather than erase them.
